Compiled on 5.29.23

John and I taped the first seven Summer 2002 Tour shows together as 5.1 mixes... an incredible run of shows with so many friends long ago. We lost touch for many years and only reconnected recently during the COVID shutdown. This show is the first time we've seen each other since that summer and I'm so glad we both made this last minute decision to make it happen! Warms the heart. <3
